description: Xmanager Power Suite 8 (Xmanager 8 / Xshell 8 / Xftp 8 / Xlpd 8). Silent InstallScript install driven by an embedded response file: one elevation prompt for the per-machine MSIs, then no wizard, installing straight into the scoop app directory.

script: if ($p.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw "Xmanager Power Suite 8 installer exited with $($p.ExitCode), see $(Join-Path $dir 'install.log')" }
foreach ($n in 'Xmanager 8','Xshell 8','Xftp 8','Xlpd 8') { if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $dir $n))) { throw "$n was not installed, see $(Join-Path $dir 'install.log')" } }

foreach ($n in 'Xmanager 8','Xshell 8','Xftp 8','Xlpd 8') { $c = Join-Path $dir (Join-Path 'Cracked File' $n); if ((Test-Path $c) -and (Test-Path (Join-Path $dir $n))) { Copy-Item -Path (Join-Path $c '*') -Destination (Join-Path $dir $n) -Force -Recurse } }

foreach ($n in 'Xmanager 8','Xshell 8','Xftp 8','Xlpd 8') { $c = Join-Path $dir (Join-Path 'Cracked File' $n); if (Test-Path $c) { foreach ($f in (Get-ChildItem -Path $c -File)) { $d = Join-Path (Join-Path $dir $n) $f.Name; if (-not (Test-Path $d)) { throw "crack file $($f.Name) was not copied into $n" }; if ((Get-Item $d).Length -ne $f.Length) { throw "crack file $($f.Name) in $n differs in size from the source patch" } } } }
foreach ($n in 'Xmanager 8','Xshell 8','Xftp 8','Xlpd 8') { if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path (Join-Path $dir $n) 'nslicense.dll'))) { throw "crack copy failed: $n\nslicense.dll missing" } }

pre_uninstall: foreach ($r in $roots) { if (Test-Path $r) { foreach ($k in (Get-ChildItem $r)) { $nm = $k.PSChildName -replace '^InstallShield_',''; if ($nm -match '^\{[0-9A-Fa-f-]{36}\}$') { $d = (Get-ItemProperty $k.PSPath -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).DisplayName; if ($d -match 'Xshell 8|Xftp 8|Xlpd 8|Xmanager 8|Xmanager Power Suite') { $ids += $nm } } } } }

if ($ids) { $cmd = (@($ids | ForEach-Object { "Start-Process msiexec -ArgumentList '/X','$_','/qn','/norestart' -Wait" }) + @($ids | ForEach-Object { "Remove-Item -LiteralPath 'HKLM:\\SOFTWARE\\WOW6432Node\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Uninstall\\InstallShield_$_' -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue" }) + @($ids | ForEach-Object { "Remove-Item -LiteralPath 'HKLM:\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Uninstall\\InstallShield_$_' -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue" }) + @($ids | ForEach-Object { "Remove-Item -LiteralPath 'C:\\Program Files (x86)\\InstallShield Installation Information\\$_' -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue" })) -join '; '; Start-Process powershell -Verb RunAs -Wait -WindowStyle Hidden -ArgumentList '-NoProfile','-Command',$cmd }
